panels.title: Transfers (fast_send)
panels.description: fast_send written to Kafka within the selected time range (topic offsets).

panels.title: Success rate

targets.expr: sum(increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="sender", outcome="fast_send_success"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="sender", outcome="fast_send_success"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="sender", outcome="fast_send_failed"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.description: success / (success + failed) of matched transfers within the selected time range.

panels.title: Completion time p95
panels.description: Time from fast_send to its outcome (matched by transaction_id), last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Stuck transfers (> 30s)
panels.description: fast_send with no outcome for more than 30 seconds.

panels.title: Failed amount (at risk)
panels.description: TRY amount of failed transfers within the selected time range.

panels.title: Bank summary (selected time range)

targets.expr: sum by (bank) (increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_success"}[$__range])) + sum by (bank) (increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_failed"}[$__range]))

sum by (bank) (increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_failed"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (bank) (increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_success"}[$__range])) + sum by (bank) (increase(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_failed"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.description: Per bank: completed transfers, outcomes, failure rate and successful TRY volume. Bank and amount come from fast_send, so this is correct even if outcome events carry only a transaction_id.

panels.title: Failure rate by bank (top 5)

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (bank) (rate(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_failed"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (bank) (rate(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_success"}[5m])) + sum by (bank) (rate(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_failed"}[5m])), 1e-9))

panels.description: failed / (success + failed) per bank, last 5 minutes; the 5 worst banks at each point in time.

targets.expr: sum by (bank) (rate(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_success"}[5m])) + sum by (bank) (rate(fast_kstreams_reconciler_transfers_total{impl="kstreams", role="$role", bank=~"$bank", outcome="fast_send_failed"}[5m]))
